tasks.label: ignex: js reference buffer
tasks.command: bun -e "import { Quote } from './src/generated/ts/quote.js'; import * as flatbuffers from 'flatbuffers'; const b = new flatbuffers.Builder(1024); const s = b.createString('AAPL'); Quote.startQuote(b); Quote.addSymbol(b, s); Quote.addBid(b, 180.25); Quote.addAsk(b, 180.3); Quote.addBidSize(b, 100n); Quote.addAskSize(b, 200n); Quote.addTs(b, 1720000000000n); const off = Quote.endQuote(b); b.finishSizePrefixed(off, 'IGNX'); const bytes = b.asUint8Array(); console.log('js len', bytes.length); console.log('js hex', Array.from(bytes.slice(0,24)).map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(' ')); const bb = new flatbuffers.ByteBuffer(bytes); const q = Quote.getSizePrefixedRootAsQuote(bb); console.log('decoded', q.symbol(), q.bid(), q.ask(), String(q.bidSize()), String(q.askSize()), String(q.ts()));"

tasks.label: ignex: frame indices
tasks.command: bun -e "import { encodeEvent } from './src/transport/transport.ts'; const frame = encodeEvent('quote', {symbol:'AAPL', bid:180.25, ask:180.3, bidSize:100, askSize:200, ts:1720000000000}); console.log('len', frame.length); let s=''; for (let i=0;i<Math.min(frame.length,32);i++) s += i.toString().padStart(2,'0')+':'+frame[i].toString(16).padStart(2,'0')+' '; console.log(s); const dv = new DataView(frame.buffer, frame.byteOffset, 16); for (const off of [0,1,4,8]) { try { console.log('u32@'+off, dv.getUint32(off, true)); } catch {} }"

tasks.label: ignex: ws.send copy semantics
tasks.command: bun -e "import { createServer } from './public/server.ts'; const server = createServer({ port: 0 }); const N = 50000; let received = 0; let ok = true; const scratch = new Uint8Array(1024); const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:'+server.port+'/ws'); ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer'; ws.onopen = () => { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { new DataView(scratch.buffer).setUint32(0, i, true); ws.send(scratch.subarray(0,4)); scratch.fill(0xaa); } }; ws.onmessage = (ev) => { const b = new Uint8Array(ev.data); const seq = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, 4).getUint32(0, true); if (b.length !== 4 || (seq >>> 24) === 0xaa) ok = false; received++; if (received === N) { console.log('send-copies-synchronously =', ok, 'received', received); server.stop(); process.exit(0); } }; setTimeout(() => { console.log('TIMEOUT ok=', ok, 'received', received); process.exit(1); }, 8000);"

tasks.label: ignex: ws.send copy semantics v2
tasks.command: bun -e "import { serve } from 'bun'; const N = 20000; const server = serve({ port: 0, fetch(req, srv) { if (srv.upgrade(req)) return undefined; return new Response('x'); }, websocket: { open(ws) { const scratch = new Uint8Array(1024); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { new DataView(scratch.buffer).setUint32(0, i, true); ws.send(scratch.subarray(0,4)); scratch.fill(0xaa); } } } }); let received = 0; let ok = true; const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:'+server.port); ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer'; ws.onmessage = (ev) => { const b = new Uint8Array(ev.data); const seq = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, 4).getUint32(0, true); if (b.length !== 4 || (seq >>> 24) === 0xaa) ok = false; received++; if (received === N) { console.log('send-copies-synchronously =', ok, 'received', received); server.stop(true); process.exit(0); } }; setTimeout(() => { console.log('TIMEOUT ok=', ok, 'received', received); process.exit(1); }, 8000);"
